articles.summary: Players can begin Mythical Void without an account, name, or email address.
articles.candidateReply: You can start playing Mythical Void without an account, name, or email address. Choose Play Now to begin in your browser.

articles.summary: Progress is stored locally by default; clearing browser data can remove a local-only save.
articles.candidateReply: Your progress is saved in this browser by default. Clearing the browser’s stored data can remove a local-only save.

articles.summary: The current browser game is free and asks for no payment details.
articles.candidateReply: The current browser game is free to play and does not ask for payment details.

articles.summary: The game runs in a current desktop or mobile browser, and a keyboard is recommended for platforming sections.
articles.candidateReply: You can play in a current desktop or mobile browser. A keyboard is recommended for the platforming parts of the adventure.

articles.summary: The adventure is made for families and includes fantasy battles without gore or adult themes.
articles.candidateReply: The adventure is made for families. It includes fantasy battles, but no gore or adult themes. A parent or guardian can read the privacy and safety page before play.

articles.summary: Cloud Save is optional, and children can play without it.
articles.candidateReply: Cloud Save is optional. Children can play without it. A child should only use Cloud Save when a parent or guardian has given any permission required where they live.

articles.summary: The parent and guardian contact channel is planned but is not open yet.
articles.candidateReply: Our parent and guardian contact channel is being prepared and is not open yet. When it opens, please do not include unnecessary personal details about a child.

articles.summary: A parent or guardian must send a young designer’s idea without the child’s surname, face, voice, school, location, or contact details.
articles.candidateReply: A parent or guardian may send a young designer’s idea. Please do not include the child’s surname, face, voice, school, location, or contact details.
